records.jp: 水上線路
records.en_original: Floating Railroad
records.en: Floating Railroad

records.jp: 迷い込んだこの世界で一番不思議なところと言えば、やっぱり辺り一面の水だよね。その水上に、線路が一本水平線まで伸びてる。こころ曰く“向こうの世界”が出てくる前からあったそうだけど、一体どこへと続く線路だったんだろう？^00^00今は“向こうの世界”への通り道として利用してるよ。たまに何かが流れ着いていることもあるから、みんなも定期的にチェックしてみて
records.en_original: The strangest part of this mysterious world would have to be the water surrounding everything. Floating atop that water is a railroad leading all the way to the horizon. According to Kokoro, it was here even before the Faraway appeared, but where could it lead to?^00^00Now it's the path we use to get to the Faraway. Sometimes things will drift ashore, so we make sure to check it regularly.
records.en: The strangest part of this mysterious world would have to be the water surrounding everything. Floating atop that water is a railroad leading all the way to the horizon. According to Kokoro, it was here even before the Faraway appeared, but where could it lead to?^00^00Now it's the path we use to get to the Faraway. Sometimes things will drift ashore, so we make sure to check it regularly.

records.jp: 桟橋
records.en_original: Pier
records.en: Pier

records.jp: 水上線路と並行して伸びている桟橋。こころのお気に入りスポット。水面を覗くとたまに魚が見えるよ。ごはんに魚が出てきたら、誰かがここで釣りをし^00たってことだね
records.en_original: A pier extending along the floating railroad. Kokoro is really fond of this spot. Sometimes you can see fish when looking into the water. If we have fish for dinner, it means that someone came here to catch it.
records.en: A pier extending along the floating railroad. Kokoro is really fond of this spot. Sometimes you can see fish when looking into the water. If we have fish for dinner, it means that someone came here to catch it.

records.jp: プール
records.en_original: Pool
records.en: Pool

records.jp: いつでもきれいな水を張るようにしているプール。みんな併設されているシャワーで一日の汗を流しているよ
records.en_original: A pool that's always filled with clean, sparkling water. The shower next to it is where we get cleaned up after a hard day's work.
records.en: A pool that's always filled with clean, sparkling water. The shower next to it is where we get cleaned up after a hard day's work.

records.jp: 校門
records.en_original: School Gate
records.en: School Gate

records.jp: どこにもつながっていない形だけの校門。その先はひたすら水面が広がっているだけ。元の世界では毎日通る場所だったけど、最近はめっきり近づいてないなあ
records.en_original: The school gate here doesn't lead anywhere. Beyond it is nothing but the expanse of sea. I used to pass through one every day back in our world, but lately I haven't even come close to it.
records.en: The school gate here doesn't lead anywhere. Beyond it is nothing but the expanse of sea. I used to pass through one every day back in our world, but lately I haven't even come close to it.

records.jp: 体育館
records.en_original: Gymnasium
records.en: Gymnasium

records.jp: ステージのある体育館。体育倉庫の中にいろんな道具があって、バドミントンやバスケもできる。久しぶりにドッジボールやりたいな。今度みんなを誘ってみよう
records.en_original: A gym complete with a stage. There's plenty of sports equipment in here, so we can play badminton, basketball, and more. It's been forever since I've played dodgeball... Maybe I'll see if everyone wants to play later!
records.en: A gym complete with a stage. There's plenty of sports equipment in here, so we can play badminton, basketball, and more. It's been forever since I've played dodgeball... Maybe I'll see if everyone wants to play later!

records.jp: 作業室
records.en_original: Work Room
records.en: Work Room

records.jp: 元々購買だったと思われるスペースを私たちが使いやすいように整えた部屋。食事に小道具、その他いろんなものを作っているので、作業室って呼んでる
records.en_original: A room we think used to be the school store that we set up for our own use. We keep all kinds of things like tableware and tools in there, so we call it the work room.
records.en: A room we think used to be the school store that we set up for our own use. We keep all kinds of things like tableware and tools in there, so we call it the work room.

records.jp: １階教室
records.en_original: 1F Classroom
records.en: 1F Classroom

records.jp: 普段みんなが過ごしてる部屋。寝るのもこの部屋だよ。怒る人は誰もいないので、好きなものを持ってきて好きなものを置いてる。そのせいでちょっと散らかってるけど、とても居心地がいい
records.en_original: This is where we usually hang out, and also where we sleep. It's gotten pretty messy because we keep finding things that we like and end up leaving them here. But no one seems to mind, and it's super comfy either way.
records.en: This is where we usually hang out, and also where we sleep. It's gotten pretty messy because we keep finding things that we like and end up leaving them here. But no one seems to mind, and it's super comfy either way.

records.jp: 校長室
records.en_original: President's Office
records.en: President's Office

records.jp: 閉ざされていて入れない部屋の一つ。きっと高そうな椅子や机があるんだろうな。一度でいいから、そんな椅子に座ってふんぞり返ってみたい
records.en_original: One of the rooms closed off to us. I bet it's equipped with a fancy chair and desk, too. Just once, I'd love to kick back and relax in a chair like that.
records.en: One of the rooms closed off to us. I bet it's equipped with a fancy chair and desk, too. Just once, I'd love to kick back and relax in a chair like that.

records.jp: 保健室
records.en_original: Nurse's Office
records.en: Nurse's Office

records.jp: 消毒液のにおいが漂う保健室。簡単な怪我の手当てぐらいならできそう。私はこの部屋のにおいも雰囲気も苦手だけど、勇希は落ち着くんだって
records.en_original: The nurse's office reeks of antiseptic. It's equipped well enough to take care of light injuries. This place makes me uncomfortable, but Yuki seems to find it calming.
records.en: The nurse's office reeks of antiseptic. It's equipped well enough to take care of light injuries. This place makes me uncomfortable, but Yuki seems to find it calming.

records.jp: 図書室
records.en_original: Library
records.en: Library

records.jp: いろんな本が置いてある図書室だよ。管理する人がいないから、どんな本も読み放題！　けど、揃えてある本のラインナップが独特で、普通の学校の図書室とは違うような……？
records.en_original: The library is stocked with a plethora of books, and since no one's watching, you can read anything for as long as you want! But the selection of reading material is very unique. Quite different from your typical school library.
records.en: The library is stocked with a plethora of books, and since no one's watching, you can read anything for as long as you want! But the selection of reading material is very unique. Quite different from your typical school library.

records.jp: 放送室
records.en_original: Broadcasting Room
records.en: Broadcasting Room

records.jp: 校内放送を行う部屋。マイクを通じて声を届けることもできるし、適当な曲を流すこともできるよ。朝昼晩の定時放送もここでやってるみたい
records.en_original: The room from which campus-wide broadcasts are made. You can use the mic to make announcements, and you can play music too. This is where the morning, afternoon, and evening broadcasts are made.
records.en: The room from which campus-wide broadcasts are made. You can use the mic to make announcements, and you can play music too. This is where the morning, afternoon, and evening broadcasts are made.

records.jp: 脚本室
records.en_original: Writers' Room
records.en: Writers' Room

records.jp: 閉ざされていて入れない部屋の一つ。多分、隣の放送室で使う脚本を作ったり、使った脚本をまとめたりしている部屋だと思う。いずれにせよ、有用なものはあんまりなさそうだね
records.en_original: One of the rooms closed off to us. The scripts for the broadcasts made in the room next door were probably written and stored here, but it doesn't seem like it has anything all that useful.
records.en: One of the rooms closed off to us. The scripts for the broadcasts made in the room next door were probably written and stored here, but it doesn't seem like it has anything all that useful.

records.jp: ２階教室
records.en_original: 2F Classroom
records.en: 2F Classroom

records.jp: 人が増えて１階教室が手狭になったので、２階の教室も使うことに。伶那さんの意向で、静かな人が集まってる。私が１階に残されてるのは、うるさいか^00らってこと……？　いいもんいいもん、こっちはこっちで楽しくやるから！
records.en_original: As more people appeared, the classroom on the first floor got pretty cramped. So now we're using a room on the second floor, too. Under Rena's request, people here are quiet. Is she trying to say the first floor people are noisy? Fine then! The party's downstairs, and we're having fun!
records.en: As more people appeared, the classroom on the first floor got pretty cramped. So now we're using a room on the second floor, too. Under Rena's request, people here are quiet. Is she trying to say the first floor people are noisy? Fine then! The party's downstairs, and we're having fun!

records.jp: トイレ
records.en_original: Bathroom
records.en: Bathroom

records.jp: 別にここについて詳しく説明する必要はないよね？　ここは何よりも自由で、救われていて、何者にも侵されてはいけない場所なんだから
records.en_original: Not much to say about this place. Above all else, it is free, safe, and must not be desecrated.
records.en: Not much to say about this place. Above all else, it is free, safe, and must not be desecrated.

records.jp: 職員室
records.en_original: Teachers' Lounge
records.en: Teachers' Lounge

records.jp: 閉ざされていて入れない部屋の一つ。元の世界でも、あんまり入ったことがないからどんな場所かはよくわかってない。入れたとしても、あんまり心地い空間じゃないと思うな
records.en_original: One of the rooms closed off to us. I rarely ever came here back in our world, so I don't really know what it's like in there. I doubt it's very comfortable, though.
records.en: One of the rooms closed off to us. I rarely ever came here back in our world, so I don't really know what it's like in there. I doubt it's very comfortable, though.

records.jp: 屋上
records.en_original: Rooftop
records.en: Rooftop

records.jp: 静かで一人になれる場所。考え事をしたいとき、誰かと大事な話をしたいときに最適。鍵がかけられていて入れない学校が多いと聞くけど、この学校は入れるみたい
records.en_original: A quiet place where you can come to have a moment alone. It's a great spot to come to when you want some time to think, or have an important talk with someone. I've heard that the roof is usually locked up at most schools, but it seems like it was left open here.
records.en: A quiet place where you can come to have a moment alone. It's a great spot to come to when you want some time to think, or have an important talk with someone. I've heard that the roof is usually locked up at most schools, but it seems like it was left open here.

records.jp: 屋上部室
records.en_original: Rooftop Storage Room
records.en: Rooftop Storage Room

records.jp: かつて何らかの部室だったと思われる部屋。今は物置としても使われているのか、よくわからないものが転がっている。伶那さんがよく訪れてるようだけど、一人でこっそり何してるんだろう？
records.en_original: I'm sure this room had some other use before, but now it's just used for storage. There's all kinds of random stuff scattered around it. Rena goes in there a lot, but what in the world could she be doing?
records.en: I'm sure this room had some other use before, but now it's just used for storage. There's all kinds of random stuff scattered around it. Rena goes in there a lot, but what in the world could she be doing?

records.jp: 民家１
records.en_original: House 1
records.en: House 1

records.jp: 人が住んでる気配がない廃屋。伶那ちゃんはちょっと怖かったみたいだけど^00……わたしはこういう雰囲気、好きだな。でも確かに、ヘビとか出てきたら危ないかも……？　あの世界にヘビっているのかな？
records.en_original: A deserted house with no signs of life. Rena seems to think it's creepy, but I like it. Though it's probably likely that there are snakes nesting in there... Wait, are there snakes in that world?
records.en: A deserted house with no signs of life. Rena seems to think it's creepy, but I like it. Though it's probably likely that there are snakes nesting in there... Wait, are there snakes in that world?

records.jp: 倒木の橋１
records.en_original: Fallen Tree Bridge 1
records.en: Fallen Tree Bridge 1

records.jp: 木が倒れかかって、橋みたいになってたところ。愛央ちゃんは、あの木を見た瞬間にもう渡ることしか考えてなかったみたい。危ないって思ったけど……そんな言葉で止まるような人じゃないことも、なんとなく分かってきたよ
records.en_original: An old tree that fell over and now works as a bridge. I get the feeling that Ao wouldn't think twice about trying to cross it. It looks a bit risky to me, but I've learned that she's not the type of person you can stop with a warning.
records.en: An old tree that fell over and now works as a bridge. I get the feeling that Ao wouldn't think twice about trying to cross it. It looks a bit risky to me, but I've learned that she's not the type of person you can stop with a warning.

records.jp: 倒木の橋２
records.en_original: Fallen Tree Bridge 2
records.en: Fallen Tree Bridge 2

records.jp: やっぱりこの世界は不思議。あちこちに大きな木が倒れていたり、変な看板が立ってたり。それにモンスターもたくさん歩いてる。変な場所ではあるけど^00……でも、ちょっとだけワクワクしちゃうかも？
records.en_original: This world really is something, isn't it? Giant trees fallen all over the place, those strange signs... Not to mention the demons prowling about. It's a very odd place, but...it's quite exciting, too.
records.en: This world really is something, isn't it? Giant trees fallen all over the place, those strange signs... Not to mention the demons prowling about. It's a very odd place, but...it's quite exciting, too.

records.jp: 民家２
records.en_original: House 2
records.en: House 2

records.jp: この世界から学校に何かを持ち帰っても、消えてなくなったりはしないみたい。それに気づいてから、勇希ちゃんがあれこれ学校に持って帰ろうとしてる。このままだと学校が物で溢れかえっちゃいそうだよ……
records.en_original: Even if we take something from this world back to the school, it seems like it doesn't disappear from here. Ever since we realized that, Yuki has been bringing all kinds of things back with us. At this rate, she'll fill up the entire school...
records.en: Even if we take something from this world back to the school, it seems like it doesn't disappear from here. Ever since we realized that, Yuki has been bringing all kinds of things back with us. At this rate, she'll fill up the entire school...

records.jp: 囲炉裏
records.en_original: Old-Fashioned Hearth
records.en: Old-Fashioned Hearth

records.jp: 大きな屋敷の中で囲炉裏を見つけた。すごくいい雰囲気で思わず足を止め^00ちゃった。モンスターがいなければゆっくり過ごせるんだけどなぁ……
records.en_original: We found a hearth in this big house we came across. It was so cozy, we couldn't help but stay a while. We could have enjoyed it even more if not for all those demons around...
records.en: We found a hearth in this big house we came across. It was so cozy, we couldn't help but stay a while. We could have enjoyed it even more if not for all those demons around...

records.jp: 浮遊灯籠
records.en_original: Floating Lanterns
records.en: Floating Lanterns

records.jp: 灯籠がふわふわ浮いてる！　不思議な世界だとは思ってたけど、こんなことも起きるなんてびっくり。現実ではありえない光景を見ると、ここが別の世界なんだって実感がわくよね
records.en_original: Lanterns just floating in midair! I already thought this was a strange place, but seeing this just blew me away! Seeing impossible things like this really makes it feel like we're in a whole new world.
records.en: Lanterns just floating in midair! I already thought this was a strange place, but seeing this just blew me away! Seeing impossible things like this really makes it feel like we're in a whole new world.

records.jp: 駅構内１
records.en_original: Train Station 1
records.en: Train Station 1

records.jp: 心の中にある駅。どこにつながっているのかも分からない、何のためにあるのかも分からない……。でも、私にとって大切な景色。それだけは分かる。ココロトープ……不思議な場所です
records.en_original: A train station in the depths of my heart. I don't know if it is actually connected to anywhere or why it is even here... But I know that it must be important to me. The Heartscape is such a strange place...
records.en: A train station in the depths of my heart. I don't know if it is actually connected to anywhere or why it is even here... But I know that it must be important to me. The Heartscape is such a strange place...

records.jp: 駅構内２
records.en_original: Train Station 2
records.en: Train Station 2

records.jp: 聞けば、靭さんのココロトープはこんなに水浸しではなかったそうです。私の世界はなんでこんなに水で溢れかえっているんだろう……。今度ここに来るときは長靴を履いてきた方がいいかもしれませんね
records.en_original: It seems that Kokoro's Heartscape was different... Why is mine flooded with all this water? It might be a good idea to wear rain boots the next time we come.
records.en: It seems that Kokoro's Heartscape was different... Why is mine flooded with all this water? It might be a good idea to wear rain boots the next time we come.

records.jp: 鉄橋の上１
records.en_original: Railway Bridge (Top) 1
records.en: Railway Bridge (Top) 1

records.jp: 人は高いところに上りたがる生き物なのだ――鉄橋を上った星崎さんが残した名言です。確かに、狩猟時代は敵や獲物の位置を把握するために視界を確保することが重要だったわけですし……いや、考えすぎですかね
records.en_original: "Humans are creatures that'll always want to climb to the top!" Ao shared these wise words with us after scaling the railway bridge. I suppose that would have been important during the hunter-gatherer era. Locating predators or prey would be easier from a high place. ...No, I'm probably overthinking it.
records.en: "Humans are creatures that'll always want to climb to the top!" Ao shared these wise words with us after scaling the railway bridge. I suppose that would have been important during the hunter-gatherer era. Locating predators or prey would be easier from a high place. ...No, I'm probably overthinking it.

records.jp: 鉄橋の上２
records.en_original: Railway Bridge (Top) 2
records.en: Railway Bridge (Top) 2

records.jp: ココロトープは心の中の景色をもとにした世界。鉄橋と、それを遮るように存在する家を見て、わたしの心の中に何かの感情が芽生えるような感覚がありました。でもそれを言葉にすることできなかった。……自分の感情を自分で理解するのは、とても難しいです
records.en_original: A Heartscape is a landscape created from our hearts. Looking at the bridge and the houses made some kind of emotion spring up in my heart, but I couldn't put it into words... Truly understanding your own emotions is a very difficult thing.
records.en: A Heartscape is a landscape created from our hearts. Looking at the bridge and the houses made some kind of emotion spring up in my heart, but I couldn't put it into words... Truly understanding your own emotions is a very difficult thing.

records.jp: 休憩スペース
records.en_original: Rest Area
records.en: Rest Area

records.jp: ちょっとした休憩スペース。夕方になって少し気温が下がったのか、あるいは水に濡れた服が体温を奪ったのか、吹き抜ける風が少し肌寒く感じました。こういうとき、温かいコーヒーが恋しくなりますね
records.en_original: A small area where one can catch their breath. I'm not sure if it was just cooler because it was evening, or if our damp clothing made us feel cool, but the breeze felt a bit chilly. A nice, hot coffee would be total bliss.
records.en: A small area where one can catch their breath. I'm not sure if it was just cooler because it was evening, or if our damp clothing made us feel cool, but the breeze felt a bit chilly. A nice, hot coffee would be total bliss.

records.jp: 公園
records.en_original: Park
records.en: Park

records.jp: わたしが公園と聞いて思い出すのは、おままごととか、砂場遊びとかそういう感じなんですが、星崎さんは違ったみたいです。人の数だけ思い出がある、そういうことですね。わたしも今度、立ちこぎジャンプしてみようかな……
records.en_original: When I think of a park, I remember playing house, or playing in a sandbox, but it seems like Ao had a different experience. She only remembers how many people were there. Maybe next time I'll try jumping of the swings...
records.en: When I think of a park, I remember playing house, or playing in a sandbox, but it seems like Ao had a different experience. She only remembers how many people were there. Maybe next time I'll try jumping of the swings...

records.jp: 草原１
records.en_original: Meadow 1
records.en: Meadow 1

records.jp: 絵画が浮いてるってどういうことだろう……。私は結構びっくりしたんだけど、愛央たちは「まあそんなもんだよね」って言っててさらにびっくり。おかしいのは私の方だった……！？
records.en_original: Paintings floating through the air... What's that all about? I was pretty surprised, but Ao and them said that's just the way things are here. That surprised me even more! Am I the strange one?!
records.en: Paintings floating through the air... What's that all about? I was pretty surprised, but Ao and them said that's just the way things are here. That surprised me even more! Am I the strange one?!

records.jp: 草原２
records.en_original: Meadow 2
records.en: Meadow 2

records.jp: ピクニックに最適そうな場所を見つけた。でも、モンスターは容赦なく襲ってくる。モンスターを追い払うために愛央が鎌を振り、そしてそのたびに散っていく花……。これが儚いってことなのかな……
records.en_original: We found an area perfect for a picnic, but the demons won't let up. Ao keeps them away by swinging her scythe, but each swing makes more and more flowers fall... I guess flowers really are fleeting...
records.en: We found an area perfect for a picnic, but the demons won't let up. Ao keeps them away by swinging her scythe, but each swing makes more and more flowers fall... I guess flowers really are fleeting...

records.jp: 荒地１
records.en_original: Wastelands 1
records.en: Wastelands 1

records.jp: 荒地で天然の滑り台を見つけた。なんだか童心に帰った気分で楽しかった。でもその代わり、体中砂だらけになっちゃった。楽しかったからいいけど！
records.en_original: We found a natural slide in the wastelands. It was so fun, I felt like I was a kid again! I got sand all over me, though. But it was totally worth it!
records.en: We found a natural slide in the wastelands. It was so fun, I felt like I was a kid again! I got sand all over me, though. But it was totally worth it!

records.jp: 荒地２
records.en_original: Wastelands 2
records.en: Wastelands 2

records.jp: ココロトープに城の城壁みたいな瓦礫があった。私はお城なんて見たことないんだけど……これも何かの感情の表れなのかな？
records.en_original: There was what looked to be the old ruins of a castle wall, but I didn't see anything that looked like a castle... Maybe this too is the manifestation of some kind of emotion.
records.en: There was what looked to be the old ruins of a castle wall, but I didn't see anything that looked like a castle... Maybe this too is the manifestation of some kind of emotion.

records.jp: 虹の橋
records.en_original: Rainbow Bridge
records.en: Rainbow Bridge

records.jp: 虹の橋の上を渡る経験なんて、二度とできないだろうな。どういう原理で上に立ててるのかは全然分からなかった。下を見ると足がすくんじゃうから、なるべく視線はまっすぐがコツ！
records.en_original: I don't think we'll be able to experience crossing a rainbow bridge ever again. I have no idea what holds it up. The key to getting across it is...don't look down!
records.en: I don't think we'll be able to experience crossing a rainbow bridge ever again. I have no idea what holds it up. The key to getting across it is...don't look down!

records.jp: 川のほとり
records.en_original: Riverside
records.en: Riverside

records.jp: 世界のあちこちに虹色の欠片が落ちてる。見たことない光り方をしてて、みんなも興味津々だったみたい。学校の教室にインテリアとして置いておいたら、ちょっとおしゃれかもね
records.en_original: Shards of rainbows fall all over this world. They shine like nothing I've ever seen before. Everyone else was really curious about them, too. It might fancy up the place if we decorated the classroom with them.
records.en: Shards of rainbows fall all over this world. They shine like nothing I've ever seen before. Everyone else was really curious about them, too. It might fancy up the place if we decorated the classroom with them.

records.jp: 浜辺１
records.en_original: Beach 1
records.en: Beach 1

records.jp: この浜辺も、元は観光客であふれかえってたと思う。でも今は誰もいない。灰の影響を受けた私たちの世界では、誰も外に出たがらないから。ココロトープの中の浜辺も、私が見た「誰もいない浜辺」をもとにしてるのかな
records.en_original: I imagine this beach was once popular with tourists, but there's no one here now. In our world, which was plagued with Ash, people stopped going out. Maybe the beach in my Heartscape was based on all those empty beaches I used to see.
records.en: I imagine this beach was once popular with tourists, but there's no one here now. In our world, which was plagued with Ash, people stopped going out. Maybe the beach in my Heartscape was based on all those empty beaches I used to see.

records.jp: 車道
records.en_original: Road
records.en: Road

records.jp: 車道が瓦礫でふさがってた。車もそれに巻き込まれて潰れてる。実際にこんな事故があったわけじゃないと思うけど……ココロトープだと、こういう崩落に巻き込まれる危険もあるってことかもしれない。
records.en_original: A road, blocked off by debris, a wrecked car among the chaos. I doubt that this really occurred but...perhaps it reflects the kind of danger that we'll face in my Heartscape.
records.en: A road, blocked off by debris, a wrecked car among the chaos. I doubt that this really occurred but...perhaps it reflects the kind of danger that we'll face in my Heartscape.

records.jp: 倉庫
records.en_original: Warehouse
records.en: Warehouse

records.jp: 森の中腹で見つけた倉庫。フェンスで囲まれてて中には入れなかったんだけど……星崎さんがあのデカい鎌でフェンスを破壊しようとし始めたから、慌てて止める羽目になった。そりゃ、中は気になるけどさ……
records.en_original: A warehouse in the forest on the mountainside. It's surrounded by a fence, so we couldn't get in. Ao was about to use her giant scythe to try and break through, but I put a stop to that. I am curious about what's inside, though...
records.en: A warehouse in the forest on the mountainside. It's surrounded by a fence, so we couldn't get in. Ao was about to use her giant scythe to try and break through, but I put a stop to that. I am curious about what's inside, though...

records.jp: 山の中腹
records.en_original: Mountainside
records.en: Mountainside

records.jp: 遠くに灯台が見える。子供の頃、お父さんに灯台に連れていってもらったことを思い出した。これも私の思い出の一つ。ちゃんと遠くの景色にも反映されてるんだね
records.en_original: There's a lighthouse in the distance. It reminded me of how my father used to take me to one when I was a kid. That's one of the memories I found. Even background things are properly reflected here...
records.en: There's a lighthouse in the distance. It reminded me of how my father used to take me to one when I was a kid. That's one of the memories I found. Even background things are properly reflected here...

records.jp: 山の頂上１
records.en_original: Mountain Peak 1
records.en: Mountain Peak 1

records.jp: 山を登り切った私たちを迎えたのは、一面の星空と輝く花畑だった。なんでだろう、ここに来ると胸の底から何かがこみあげてくるような感じがする。私にとって大切な場所。思い出の空だ
records.en_original: We finally reached the summit to find a glittering flower bed under a starry sky. I felt a rush of emotions dredged up from the bottom of my heart just being here, but I don't know why... This sky from my memories must truly be a special place to me.
records.en: We finally reached the summit to find a glittering flower bed under a starry sky. I felt a rush of emotions dredged up from the bottom of my heart just being here, but I don't know why... This sky from my memories must truly be a special place to me.

records.jp: 山の頂上２
records.en_original: Mountain Peak 2
records.en: Mountain Peak 2

records.jp: 別荘？　森のペンション？　そういう類の家を見つけた。家の中には入れな^00かったけど、周りに置いてあるテーブルだとかベンチだとかは自由に使ってもいいみたい。自然豊かな森の中でゆっくり過ごすのも、たまにはいいんじゃない？
records.en_original: We found a...villa? Or was it a cabin? We couldn't go inside, but the tables and benches outside it were free to us. It was nice to spend some time relaxing outdoors.
records.en: We found a...villa? Or was it a cabin? We couldn't go inside, but the tables and benches outside it were free to us. It was nice to spend some time relaxing outdoors.

records.jp: 川沿い
records.en_original: Riverbank
records.en: Riverbank

records.jp: 水の流れる音は人に安らぎをもたらすと言われる。きららも自然の中で暮らすのは好きだ。全身の感覚が研ぎ澄まされて、精神が落ち着くのを感じる。きららの第六感も冴えわたる。みょんみょんみょん
records.en_original: They say that the sound of flowing water brings a sense of peace. I very much enjoy spending time in nature. I can feel it sharpening my senses and soothing my soul. Even my sixth sense is getting clearer. Byew-yew-yew...
records.en: They say that the sound of flowing water brings a sense of peace. I very much enjoy spending time in nature. I can feel it sharpening my senses and soothing my soul. Even my sixth sense is getting clearer. Byew-yew-yew...

records.jp: 祭り会場
records.en_original: Festival Grounds
records.en: Festival Grounds

records.jp: お祭りの多い村だった。きららも親に連れられてよく参加したけど……友達が少なかったから、そんなにいい思い出は多くない。だから、ココロトープでみんなと一緒にお祭りを回れて、よかった
records.en_original: My village held many festivals. My parents would take me often... But since I didn't have many friends, I don't have many good memories of them. I'm glad I was able to go to the festival with everyone in my Heartscape.
records.en: My village held many festivals. My parents would take me often... But since I didn't have many friends, I don't have many good memories of them. I'm glad I was able to go to the festival with everyone in my Heartscape.

records.jp: お墓
records.en_original: Graveyard
records.en: Graveyard

records.jp: きららは静かな場所が好き。人の多い場所にいると頭が痛くなってしまうから。その点、お墓は静かで居心地がいい……と思ってたけど、どうやらきららは普通じゃないらしい。伶那にすごい顔で見られた。ショック
records.en_original: I like quiet places. I get headaches when there are too many people around. Thus, I find locations such as graveyards quite comfortable...but that seems to be abnormal. Rena gave me the strangest look. I had no idea.
records.en: I like quiet places. I get headaches when there are too many people around. Thus, I find locations such as graveyards quite comfortable...but that seems to be abnormal. Rena gave me the strangest look. I had no idea.

records.jp: 池
records.en_original: Pond
records.en: Pond

records.jp: どうやら詩帆は池に浮かぶ葉っぱに乗れると思って沈んだことがあるらしい。今の詩帆からは想像しにくいけど、幼馴染のこころによれば「昔はもっと活発だった」だそう
records.en_original: Apparently Shiho used to try to get on the leaves floating in a pond, but she would always sink. It's hard to imagine looking at her now, but Kokoro says that Shiho was quite a boisterous child.
records.en: Apparently Shiho used to try to get on the leaves floating in a pond, but she would always sink. It's hard to imagine looking at her now, but Kokoro says that Shiho was quite a boisterous child.

records.jp: 大広間
records.en_original: Reception Hall
records.en: Reception Hall

records.jp: 大広間に出ると、どこからか線香の香りがした。懐かしい。昔はこの匂いばかり嗅いでいたな。香りまで再現するなんて、ココロトープ恐るべし
records.en_original: The reception hall is thick with the aroma of incense. It's a smell that brings back memories. My Heartscape is full of smells from my childhood. That it can reproduce even odors is truly incredible.
records.en: The reception hall is thick with the aroma of incense. It's a smell that brings back memories. My Heartscape is full of smells from my childhood. That it can reproduce even odors is truly incredible.

records.jp: 縁側
records.en_original: Veranda
records.en: Veranda

records.jp: 月は人を魅了し、狂気に陥れるという。縁側から見上げる月は神秘的で、さすがのきららも言葉を失った。これぞ日本の文化。愛央は眠くなると言っていたが……うむ、文化の受容のしかたは人それぞれだ
records.en_original: I've heard that the moon makes some fall in love, and others fall into madness. There's something so mystical about the sight of the moon from the veranda that even I can't quite put into words. It's the quintessential Japanese scene. Ao said it just made her sleepy... Hmph. To each their own, I suppose.
records.en: I've heard that the moon makes some fall in love, and others fall into madness. There's something so mystical about the sight of the moon from the veranda that even I can't quite put into words. It's the quintessential Japanese scene. Ao said it just made her sleepy... Hmph. To each their own, I suppose.

records.jp: 公園１
records.en_original: Park 1
records.en: Park 1

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんは子供の頃、ブランコで靴飛ばししてたんだって。私もよくお姉^00ちゃんを連れて公園に遊びに来てたなぁ……。大人に近づくにつれて、そういうはしゃぎ方ってできなくなっていくけど……思い出だけは忘れずにいたいよね
records.en_original: Ao said that when she was a kid, she'd try and kick her shoes as far as she could from the swing. I used to go to parks a lot with Mio too... But as we got older, we weren't able to play like that anymore. I hope I can keep those memories forever, even if that's all I have.
records.en: Ao said that when she was a kid, she'd try and kick her shoes as far as she could from the swing. I used to go to parks a lot with Mio too... But as we got older, we weren't able to play like that anymore. I hope I can keep those memories forever, even if that's all I have.

records.jp: 公園２
records.en_original: Park 2
records.en: Park 2

records.jp: 公園の隅に用意された水辺。ちょうど木陰になっていて、涼しくて気持ちいいわね。図書室の本を持ってきてここで読むのも良さそう。せっかく学校も海に囲まれてるわけだし、こういう休憩場所を用意してみるのもいいかもしれないわね
records.en_original: A waterfront set up in a corner of the park. It's nice and cool, right in the shade of the trees. It looks like the perfect spot to sit and read a library book. Seeing as the school is surrounded by water, it would be a shame not to set up a few areas like this.
records.en: A waterfront set up in a corner of the park. It's nice and cool, right in the shade of the trees. It looks like the perfect spot to sit and read a library book. Seeing as the school is surrounded by water, it would be a shame not to set up a few areas like this.

records.jp: キャンプ跡
records.en_original: Campsite Remains
records.en: Campsite Remains

records.jp: キャンプの跡地みたいな机と椅子のセットを見つけた。シンプルだけど結構おしゃれで好きなデザイン！　お皿とかも置いてあったけど……素材と違って、持って帰るのはなんだか気が引けるんだよね。自分のココロトープなのにね
records.en_original: We found a desk and chair that look like they used to be part of a campsite! They're simple, but kinda stylish! There were dishes lying around, too... But I don't feel right about just taking the stuff, even if it is my own Heartscape!
records.en: We found a desk and chair that look like they used to be part of a campsite! They're simple, but kinda stylish! There were dishes lying around, too... But I don't feel right about just taking the stuff, even if it is my own Heartscape!

records.jp: 教会
records.en_original: Church
records.en: Church

records.jp: 大きな教会があった。私たちのココロトープに教会があるのは、納得ではあるわね。ここにはいろいろな思い出があるわ。いいことも、そうでないことも^00……一言では語りつくせないくらいのね
records.en_original: A large church. I can understand why there would be a church in our Heartscape. We have many memories here...some good, some not so much. It's hard to explain without going into detail.
records.en: A large church. I can understand why there would be a church in our Heartscape. We have many memories here...some good, some not so much. It's hard to explain without going into detail.

records.jp: 観覧車
records.en_original: Ferris Wheel
records.en: Ferris Wheel

records.jp: 観覧車！　明らかに本物の観覧車より大きくて驚いちゃった。ココロトープは主の主観で世界が作られるって話だから、これも小さい頃の私とお姉ちゃんが感じた観覧車、ってことみたい。成長を感じるね！
records.en_original: Whoo, a Ferris wheel! It's even bigger than the real thing, I was blown away! I guess it's because a Heartscape is made from the point of view of its owner, and it looked that big to Mio and I when we were kids. It makes me feel kinda grown up now!
records.en: Whoo, a Ferris wheel! It's even bigger than the real thing, I was blown away! I guess it's because a Heartscape is made from the point of view of its owner, and it looked that big to Mio and I when we were kids. It makes me feel kinda grown up now!

records.jp: ビル群
records.en_original: Skyscraper District
records.en: Skyscraper District

records.jp: ビルが壁に刺さってる……。ココロトープはなんでもありらしいけど、こんなものもあるのね。陽桜莉には近づいたら危ないと伝えたけれど、ここでしか見られない景色だと思うと、私も少しワクワクしてしまうかも
records.en_original: Buildings piercing straight through walls... It truly seems that anything goes in the Heartscape. I told Hiori not to get too close since it might be dangerous, but when I think that it's a sight one can only witness here, I do find it quite exciting myself...
records.en: Buildings piercing straight through walls... It truly seems that anything goes in the Heartscape. I told Hiori not to get too close since it might be dangerous, but when I think that it's a sight one can only witness here, I do find it quite exciting myself...

records.jp: かかし
records.en_original: Scarecrow
records.en: Scarecrow

records.jp: かかしのアイデンティティは麦わら帽子にあるそうです。しかし、本来かかしの用途は鳥や害獣を追い払うこと。ココロトープに害獣はやってくるのでしょうか？　それとも、モンスターを追い払ってくれているのでしょうか
records.en_original: What makes a scarecrow? Certainly its straw hat. But they're meant to scare off birds and other animals. Does that mean there are those kinds of creatures in my Heartscape? Or is it supposed to drive away demons?
records.en: What makes a scarecrow? Certainly its straw hat. But they're meant to scare off birds and other animals. Does that mean there are those kinds of creatures in my Heartscape? Or is it supposed to drive away demons?

records.jp: ポスト
records.en_original: Postbox
records.en: Postbox

records.jp: ポストです。何の変哲もないポストです。でも、ココロトープにあるというのが不思議ですね。本来の目的を失った、思い出の中のポスト。白井さんは「私の心に届くのかも」とおっしゃっていました。実際に届いたら、どんな感覚なんでしょう
records.en_original: A simple, run-of-the-mill postbox. But the fact that it's in my Heartscape is strange, isn't it? A postbox from my memories... A postbox that's lost its purpose. Hinako suggested that it might deliver things to my heart. I wonder what it would feel like to have something reach that destination...
records.en: A simple, run-of-the-mill postbox. But the fact that it's in my Heartscape is strange, isn't it? A postbox from my memories... A postbox that's lost its purpose. Hinako suggested that it might deliver things to my heart. I wonder what it would feel like to have something reach that destination...

records.jp: 梨畑
records.en_original: Pear Orchard
records.en: Pear Orchard

records.jp: 梨畑を見つけました。ずっと疑問だったんですが、心の中の世界で手に入れたものでおなかを満たすというのはどういうことなんでしょう。何が私たちの栄養となり、血肉となるのでしょうか？　……そういうことは考えない方がよいのでしょうか？
records.en_original: A field of pear trees that we found. I've been wondering what it means for us to be nourished by the food we get from a world made of our hearts. What, exactly, is nourishing us? What is becoming our flesh and blood? Perhaps it would be better not to think about such things...
records.en: A field of pear trees that we found. I've been wondering what it means for us to be nourished by the food we get from a world made of our hearts. What, exactly, is nourishing us? What is becoming our flesh and blood? Perhaps it would be better not to think about such things...

records.jp: ネオン
records.en_original: Neon Signs
records.en: Neon Signs

records.jp: 立ち並ぶ建物と、そこに光るネオンの看板。書いてある内容は支離滅裂でしたが、ココロトープ内にある文章はたいていこんな感じなんだそうです
records.en_original: Rows of buildings with glowing neon signs on them. I couldn't make heads or tails of what they said... It seems like the Heartscape might have its own language.
records.en: Rows of buildings with glowing neon signs on them. I couldn't make heads or tails of what they said... It seems like the Heartscape might have its own language.

records.jp: ひまわり迷路
records.en_original: Sunflower Maze
records.en: Sunflower Maze

records.jp: ひまわり迷路の入り口です。記憶を取り戻すためにはこの先に進む必要がある。そんな一筋縄ではいかない様子が何とも私らしい……そう思えてしまうのが嫌ですね。面倒な性格だと指摘されているような気持ちです
records.en_original: The entrance to a maze of sunflowers. I'll have to go through it in order to recover my memories. It makes sense that things wouldn't be straightforward for me...but I hate that. It feels like it's emphasizing how difficult I am...
records.en: The entrance to a maze of sunflowers. I'll have to go through it in order to recover my memories. It makes sense that things wouldn't be straightforward for me...but I hate that. It feels like it's emphasizing how difficult I am...

records.jp: 思い出の部屋
records.en_original: Room of Memories
records.en: Room of Memories

records.jp: 私の部屋に置いてあったソファやクッション、ぬいぐるみなどが再現されていました。改めて断っておきますがこれは私の趣味ではありません。母が勝手に用意したものです。私は一切興味がなかったから放置していただけです。本当です
records.en_original: The sofa, the cushions, the teddy bear, everything in my room was recreated here. I'll say it again, I have no interest in any of these things. They were all put here by my mother of her own accord. I just left them here because I am not interested in them at all... Really.
records.en: The sofa, the cushions, the teddy bear, everything in my room was recreated here. I'll say it again, I have no interest in any of these things. They were all put here by my mother of her own accord. I just left them here because I am not interested in them at all... Really.

records.jp: 中央ホール
records.en_original: Central Hall
records.en: Central Hall

records.jp: 坪庭があって吹き抜けになっている大きなホール。ここからいろんな病棟に繋がってるのかな？　こんな場所があるなんて、勇希がいた病院は相当大きかったんだと思う
records.en_original: The atrium of a hospital. It's a big hall with a courtyard in it. Is this place connected to all the different wards? The fact that this is here means that the hospital Yuki was in must have been pretty big...
records.en: The atrium of a hospital. It's a big hall with a courtyard in it. Is this place connected to all the different wards? The fact that this is here means that the hospital Yuki was in must have been pretty big...

records.jp: 公衆電話
records.en_original: Pay Phone
records.en: Pay Phone

records.jp: 公衆電話だね。今はスマホがあるから街中では全然見かけないけど、こういう病院とかにはまだあるみたい。それもいずれなくなっちゃうのかな？　元の世界に戻れたら、まだあるうちに使ってみよう……
records.en_original: A pay phone. You rarely ever see these anymore since everyone has a smartphone now, but places like hospitals still seem to have some. I wonder if these'll disappear someday too. I should try using one when I get back to our world while I still have the chance...
records.en: A pay phone. You rarely ever see these anymore since everyone has a smartphone now, but places like hospitals still seem to have some. I wonder if these'll disappear someday too. I should try using one when I get back to our world while I still have the chance...

records.jp: 浜辺２
records.en_original: Beach 2
records.en: Beach 2

records.jp: 浜辺に落ちていた星屑。伶那さんのココロトープの中で見たのと同じものだね。きっと勇希の心に伶那さんが影響を与えたってことなんだろうな。けど、前に見たものよりなんだかくすんじゃってる……
records.en_original: Stardust fallen on the beach. It's the same as what we saw in Rena's Heartscape. Rena must have really left a lasting impression on Yuki's heart. But somehow it looks dimmer than what we saw before...
records.en: Stardust fallen on the beach. It's the same as what we saw in Rena's Heartscape. Rena must have really left a lasting impression on Yuki's heart. But somehow it looks dimmer than what we saw before...

records.jp: 浜辺３
records.en_original: Beach 3
records.en: Beach 3

records.jp: 伶那さんのココロトープの中にもあった灯台だね。誰かと同じ景色の記憶を強く想っている……なんだか強い絆が感じられてちょっとうらやましい
records.en_original: That's the same lighthouse as the one we saw in Rena's Heartscape. Yuki's memories share the same scenery as Rena's... Feeling how strong their bond is almost makes me jealous.
records.en: That's the same lighthouse as the one we saw in Rena's Heartscape. Yuki's memories share the same scenery as Rena's... Feeling how strong their bond is almost makes me jealous.

records.jp: 高台
records.en_original: Hill
records.en: Hill

records.jp: 星を見るのにぴったりの高台。ひんやりした風と潮の匂いで独特な雰囲気があるよ。伶那さんと勇希はここで星を見ようって約束したんだっけ。きっと同じ夢を見たはずなのに、二人の間でこんなにも見える景色が違うんだなあ……
records.en_original: A small hill perfect for stargazing. A gentle breeze paired with the scent of the sea gives this place a really special mood. Is this where Rena and Yuki promised to meet? They both dreamed of the same thing, but the way they saw it was so different...
records.en: A small hill perfect for stargazing. A gentle breeze paired with the scent of the sea gives this place a really special mood. Is this where Rena and Yuki promised to meet? They both dreamed of the same thing, but the way they saw it was so different...

records.jp: 輝く花畑
records.en_original: Glowing Flower Bed
records.en: Glowing Flower Bed

records.jp: すっかり荒れ果てた景色の奥で、隠れるように咲いていた光る花の花畑。死が間近に迫った勇希はいろんなことを諦めたと思う。きっとこの花たちは、それでも諦めることができずにしまい込んだ、勇希の大切な何かだ
records.en_original: Hidden beyond a scene of total desolation lay a field of glowing flowers. I think Yuki began to give up on many things as her death drew closer. But within these flowers is something very important to Yuki—something that she was never able to give up on.
records.en: Hidden beyond a scene of total desolation lay a field of glowing flowers. I think Yuki began to give up on many things as her death drew closer. But within these flowers is something very important to Yuki—something that she was never able to give up on.

records.jp: 喜びの花畑
records.en_original: Garden of Happiness
records.en: Garden of Happiness

records.jp: コモンにあった、喜びの感情が集まる領域を模した場所だよ。気持ちのいい景色が広がってるよね！　ユズもよくここで水浴びしてたよ
records.en_original: This place was modeled after a zone of the Common brimming with joy. Doesn't it look like pure happiness?! Yuzu would come here for a dip all the time.
records.en: This place was modeled after a zone of the Common brimming with joy. Doesn't it look like pure happiness?! Yuzu would come here for a dip all the time.

records.jp: 恐怖の森
records.en_original: Forest of Fear
records.en: Forest of Fear

records.jp: コモンにあった、恐怖の感情が集まる領域を模した場所だよ。魔女が住んでそうなんて話をみんなしてたけど……コモンの中に住んで不思議な力を使ってたユズたちは、もしかして魔女だった！？
records.en_original: This place was modeled after a zone of the Common steeped in fear. Everyone was saying that it looks like a place where witches would live... Lime and I used to live in the Common and use special powers, so I guess we were kind of like witches!
records.en: This place was modeled after a zone of the Common steeped in fear. Everyone was saying that it looks like a place where witches would live... Lime and I used to live in the Common and use special powers, so I guess we were kind of like witches!

records.jp: 怒りのマグマ
records.en_original: Lava Flow of Rage
records.en: Lava Flow of Rage

records.jp: コモンにあった、怒りの感情が集まる領域を模した場所だよ。落ちたら絶対に助からないから、みんな足元には気を付けて！
records.en_original: This place was modeled after a zone of the Common filled with rage. You're done for if you fall in, so you'd better watch your step!
records.en: This place was modeled after a zone of the Common filled with rage. You're done for if you fall in, so you'd better watch your step!

records.jp: 悲しみの石柱
records.en_original: Pillar of Sadness
records.en: Pillar of Sadness

records.jp: コモンの中にある、人々の悲しみの感情が集まる領域を模した場所。景色から悲しさを感じ取るなんて、さすがリフレクターといったところ
records.en_original: This place was modeled after a zone in the center of the Common saturated with sadness. Being able to feel the sorrow of one's surroundings is part and parcel of being a Reflector.
records.en: This place was modeled after a zone in the center of the Common saturated with sadness. Being able to feel the sorrow of one's surroundings is part and parcel of being a Reflector.

records.jp: 想いの中心地
records.en_original: Emotional Core
records.en: Emotional Core

records.jp: コモンの中心を模した場所。世界が滅びる前、ライムたちはここでずっとみんなの想いを感じてたの。そうして不穏な気配を察知しては、できる限りの対処をしてたんだ
records.en_original: This place was modeled after the very heart of the Common. Before the destruction of the world, this is where we would sense everyone's emotions, and do everything in our power to take care of the disturbances we felt.
records.en: This place was modeled after the very heart of the Common. Before the destruction of the world, this is where we would sense everyone's emotions, and do everything in our power to take care of the disturbances we felt.

records.jp: 管理区域
records.en_original: Access Control Area
records.en: Access Control Area

records.jp: 雫世界の管理区域だよ。こうしてみると、ライムたちの作った世界は本当に小さい。それでもかけがえのない想いを乗せている。絶対に無に飲まれるわけにはいかない
records.en_original: The area that controls access to Oasis. The world that we made looks so small from here. And yet, it houses so many irreplaceable emotions. We can't allow them to be swallowed into nothingness.
records.en: The area that controls access to Oasis. The world that we made looks so small from here. And yet, it houses so many irreplaceable emotions. We can't allow them to be swallowed into nothingness.

records.jp: ラクガキ
records.en_original: Graffiti
records.en: Graffiti

records.jp: 街でたまに見かける落書き。私はてっきりNekoだと思ってたけど、どうやらHeroらしい。ヒーローに憧れてるなら、こんなラクガキなんかしてないでやるべきことはもっとあると思う
records.en_original: I spot graffiti around town from time to time. I was sure that this said "neko," but apparently it's "hero." If you're trying to be a hero, there are probably better things for you to do than graffiti.
records.en: I spot graffiti around town from time to time. I was sure that this said "neko," but apparently it's "hero." If you're trying to be a hero, there are probably better things for you to do than graffiti.

records.jp: 飛び出し注意の看板
records.en_original: Warning Sign
records.en: Warning Sign

records.jp: 女の子のイラストが描かれた飛びだし注意の看板だよ。運転してる人から見ると、こんなのでもヒヤッとするのかな？　驚かせちゃうのは申し訳ないけど、これで守られた命もきっとある
records.en_original: A traffic sign with a picture of a girl on it, warning drivers to look out for kids running out into the street. I wonder if seeing a sign like this would be alarming. It's too bad if it freaks people out, but I'm sure it's saved quite a few lives.
records.en: A traffic sign with a picture of a girl on it, warning drivers to look out for kids running out into the street. I wonder if seeing a sign like this would be alarming. It's too bad if it freaks people out, but I'm sure it's saved quite a few lives.

records.jp: 幹線道路
records.en_original: Main Road
records.en: Main Road

records.jp: このあたりで一番交通量の多い太い道路。大自然の中と違って、こうした人工的な場所に誰もいないと、世界にただ一人だけになってしまったみたいで^00ちょっと怖い
records.en_original: The biggest and busiest road in the area. Unlike in nature, it feels super creepy when man-made places like this are devoid of people. Like you're the only human left in the entire world.
records.en: The biggest and busiest road in the area. Unlike in nature, it feels super creepy when man-made places like this are devoid of people. Like you're the only human left in the entire world.

records.jp: コンビニ
records.en_original: Convenience Store
records.en: Convenience Store

records.jp: 私の家と学校までの間にあるコンビニ。ここで買ったお菓子を教室でこっそりみんなと分けたり、放課後はここで買い食いしていったり……。そんなささやかな楽しみを与えてくれる便利なお店だ
records.en_original: A convenience store on the way to campus from my house. I come here to buy snacks to share with my friends during class, or grab a bite on my way home. It's a convenient little shop that adds a small bit of joy to my day.
records.en: A convenience store on the way to campus from my house. I come here to buy snacks to share with my friends during class, or grab a bite on my way home. It's a convenient little shop that adds a small bit of joy to my day.

records.jp: 横断歩道
records.en_original: Crosswalk
records.en: Crosswalk

records.jp: 魔の横断歩道。ここの信号に引っ掛かると遅刻しちゃうんだ。もっと早く家を出ろって言われたけど、お布団が私を放してくれないんだから仕方ないよね
records.en_original: The crosswalk from hell! If you miss the light, it takes FOREVER for it to change back! I know I should just leave home earlier, but it's so hard to get out of bed in the morning...
records.en: The crosswalk from hell! If you miss the light, it takes FOREVER for it to change back! I know I should just leave home earlier, but it's so hard to get out of bed in the morning...

records.jp: 住宅
records.en_original: Houses
records.en: Houses

records.jp: 私の家の近所にある住宅。勇希がチャイムを鳴らそうとした家にはたしか気難しいおじいさんが住んでいたはず。だから一瞬怒られるかもってヒヤッっとしたけど、ココロトープの中だから人は居ないんだった
records.en_original: The houses in my neighborhood. Yuki rang the doorbell of a house that I think this cranky old guy lived at. I was really scared for a second, but then I remembered that we're in my Heartscape...
records.en: The houses in my neighborhood. Yuki rang the doorbell of a house that I think this cranky old guy lived at. I was really scared for a second, but then I remembered that we're in my Heartscape...
